parameters.notes: Orders API: GET /v1/orders/{id} con Header Auth (Bearer Access Token).
Aprobado = status "processed" Y status_detail "accredited". Ojo: processed+refunded tambien es processed pero NO es un pago valido.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO orders
  (code, status, mp_payment_id, mp_status, external_reference, buyer_name, buyer_email, amount_cop, paid_at)
VALUES (
  $1::jsonb->>'order_code',
  'paid',
  $1::jsonb->>'mp_payment_id',
  $1::jsonb->>'mp_status',
  $1::jsonb->>'external_reference',
  $1::jsonb->>'buyer_name',
  $1::jsonb->>'buyer_email',
  ($1::jsonb->>'amount_cop')::int,
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  mp_payment_id = EXCLUDED.mp_payment_id,
  mp_status = EXCLUDED.mp_status,
  external_reference = EXCLUDED.external_reference,
  buyer_name = EXCLUDED.buyer_name,
  buyer_email = EXCLUDED.buyer_email,
  paid_at = COALESCE(orders.paid_at, EXCLUDED.paid_at)
RETURNING id, code, buyer_email, buyer_name;

nodes.name: Prepare Order
nodes.notes: Builds one JSON payload so Upsert Order can use a single parameterized $1 (quotes, commas and newlines are safe).

_comment: Validates the Mercado Pago x-signature, checks idempotency against webhook_events, fetches the payment, and on approval upserts the order and emails the Tally intake link. Webhook responds 200 immediately (responseMode=onReceived) so MP never times out. All Postgres values are parameterized ($1::jsonb); no user data is interpolated into SQL text.
